source: 原创整理（风格描述为通用美术术语，不复制任何作品的具体画面）
note: 视觉风格模式库。**不是固定模板选择器**：art_director.py 会把 2–3 个风格的可混合轴（shape / material / light / texture）重新组合，产出混血提案。每个风格带 risks —— 生图通道实际做不到的部分必须写进降级说明。

styles.tokens: hand-painted illustration, visible brush strokes, thick impasto texture, warm rim light from upper left, painterly edges
styles.negative: 3d render, plastic sheen, vector flat, pixel art, photo
risks: 小尺寸下笔触会糊成一团，精灵类需提高对比
AI 容易把笔触画成噪点

styles.tokens: watercolor picture book illustration, soft pigment bleeding, cold-press paper grain, gentle washes, muted edges, children's book warmth
styles.negative: hard outline, digital gradient, 3d render, photo, neon
risks: 透明度容易失控，抠图会带走浅色边缘
深色主体必须换浅底

styles.tokens: 16-bit pixel art, limited palette, hard pixel edges, dithering shading, no anti-aliasing
styles.negative: smooth gradient, blurry, vector, 3d render, high resolution detail
risks: AI 出不了精确像素网格，必须程序化重采样
低分辨率素材与高清 UI 会打架

styles.tokens: low poly 3d render, flat shaded triangles, soft ambient occlusion, minimal texture, clean silhouettes
styles.negative: hand-drawn, watercolor, pixel art, high poly, photoreal
risks: 单张出图能看，成套一致性差
需要统一的相机角度否则像拼贴

styles.tokens: layered paper cutout diorama, visible paper edges, soft drop shadows between layers, matte cardstock, craft feel
styles.negative: 3d render, glossy, digital paint, pixel art, neon
risks: 层间投影必须程序化补，否则像平面贴纸
细节少，靠层次而不是细节取胜

styles.tokens: claymation stop-motion look, fingerprint texture, soft plasticine surfaces, warm practical lighting, shallow depth of field
styles.negative: flat vector, pixel art, crisp digital, photo
risks: 指纹纹理在 128px 下变成脏点
高光容易过曝

styles.tokens: isometric diorama, 2:1 projection, miniature model on a round base, tilt-shift depth of field, warm desk lamp light
styles.negative: perspective vanishing point, side view, flat 2d, photo
risks: 等距比例必须写死，AI 会画出透视
边界需要裁切

styles.tokens: retro CRT screen aesthetic, scanlines, phosphor glow, chromatic aberration, vignette, low resolution glow
styles.negative: clean modern ui, flat vector, watercolor
risks: 扫描线与 UI 文字冲突，文字必须程序化渲染
滤镜开销高，移动端需降级

styles.tokens: chinese ink wash painting, sumi-e brush strokes, rice paper absorbency, large negative space, single accent color
styles.negative: 3d render, glossy, pixel art, dense detail, neon
risks: 留白多，可读性依赖构图
小元素容易糊

styles.tokens: bold comic book inking, heavy black outlines, halftone dot shading, dynamic diagonal composition, limited spot colors
styles.negative: soft watercolor, 3d render, thin lines, muted palette
risks: 粗描边在小尺寸下吃掉细节
网点在缩放时产生摩尔纹

styles.tokens: surreal dreamscape, impossible geometry, floating objects, muted desaturated palette with one saturated accent, soft volumetric haze
risks: 可读性最差，玩法元素必须高对比
AI 容易画成抽象噪声

styles.tokens: minimal geometric abstraction, two-color palette, precise circles and rectangles, generous negative space, flat shading
risks: 极度依赖构图，做不好就是无聊
对动画质量要求最高
